sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 47.4 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 14.6 grams, the best number here but still only modest help. Omega 3 is 90 milligrams, not adding much omega 3, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, the fat profile is one of the biggest reasons they earn their place.

It's good for bone health, immune support, and muscles and strength sports because magnesium can support bones, zinc helps support the immune system, and the protein section supports repair and maintenance.
